vulnerability_analysis: The contract has owner-only functions that allow draining ETH from the contract. The withdraw() function lets the owner withdraw all ETH balance. Additionally, the owner can set marketing address to their own address and trigger fee collection. The vulnerability is owner privilege abuse where we can become the owner and drain funds.
attack_strategy: 1. Use storage slot manipulation to become the owner by overwriting the _owner variable at slot 0. 2. Call withdraw() to transfer all ETH from the contract to ourselves. 3. Alternatively, we could also set marketing address to our address and trigger fee collection, but withdraw() is simpler.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Determine the current contract balance (optional). 2. Use vm.store() to overwrite the owner storage slot (slot 0) with our address. 3. Call withdraw() as the new owner to drain all ETH. 4. Verify our balance increased.
